coverage.summary: Applies to tenancies (estates) at will; no unit-count, building-age or owner-occupancy limits stated.

evidence.quoted_span: Estates at will may be determined by either party by three months' notice in writing for that purpose given to the other party
Estates at will may be determined by either party by three months' notice in writing for that purpose given to the other party

result.notes: The coverage was confirmed against D051 (G.L. c. 186, § 12), and no changes were needed. The section applies only to estates (tenancies) at will. Nonpayment terminations under written leases fall under § 11 (D050). The text sets no limits on unit count, construction date, owner occupancy or landlord size, so those fields stay null.
